title: maximilianea parvifolia
intro: Maximilianea parvifolia, commonly known as the "Barriguda" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and infections.
